verdict.rationale: Warp ships multiple official CLIs — the standalone Warp Agent CLI usable in any terminal/SSH (warp-docs-23, warp-docs-41, warp-docs-59, warp-docs-69) and the Oz CLI for managing cloud agents in scripts/CI (warp-docs-22, warp-docs-37, warp-docs-52) — both extensively documented as first-party, agent-native tooling with API key auth for headless use (warp-docs-63). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration specifically validating the CLI's real-world reliability (community evidence covers the desktop app, not the CLI).
